subject: Exciting SWE Internship Opportunity at TechCorp
body:
Hi,

I came across your profile on LinkedIn and was impressed by your background in software engineering.

We have an open Software Engineer Intern position at TechCorp for Summer 2025 and I think you'd be a great fit.

Would you be available for a quick 20-minute call this week or next to discuss the role further? Please let me know your availability.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
Sarah Mitchell
Technical Recruiter, TechCorp

subject: Project Status Update Required
body:
Dear Student,

I wanted to follow up regarding the NLP project you are working on this semester.

The mid-semester review is scheduled for next week and I have not yet received your progress report. Could you please send me a brief update on where you currently stand — what has been completed, what is in progress, and any blockers you are facing?

Please respond by Friday.

Regards,
Prof. Anand Sharma
Department of Computer Science

subject: Re: Study Group Meeting This Weekend
body:
Hey,

Just confirming — we're meeting Saturday at 3 PM at the college library, second floor. Karan and Priya are also coming.

Can you make it? Also bring your notes from the OS lecture if you have them.

Thanks,
Rohan
